'''Ithorian razor sharks''' were a [[Diet/Legends|predatory]] [[Fish/Legends|fish]] that lived in the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="ITHOR">{{CSWECite|II|123|Ithor}}</ref> [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]. The [[Shark/Legends|sharks]] had [[Dagger/Legends|dagger]]-like [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] that lined their large [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]].<ref name="CSWE" /> In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force]]'' to [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].</ref> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] saw a [[draigon]]&mdash;a [[Color/Legends|silver]]-scaled [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]] with yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and large needle-like teeth that arced from its gums&mdash;and was vaguely reminded of an Ithorian razor shark.<ref name="Rising Force">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ithorian razor sharks were first mentioned in ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force]]'', a [[1999]] young-readers novel written by [[Jude Watson]] as the first entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice]]'' series.<ref name="Rising Force" />
